Prototype 9 encodes N2 (100% pure) primarily through EEG (97%), with EOG (2%) and EMG (1%) contribution.
Its EEG signature shows elevated β_h (+1.0 dB, sensitivity=11.2) and elevated δ (+7.5 dB, sensitivity=8.2).
The β_h activity is present in 14% of each epoch (transient), with moderate eye movements (SEM 34% active) and intermediate muscle tone.
This is coherent with N2 physiology: σ elevated, σ relevant, EOG quiescent — all confirmed. Note: model primarily uses β_h, atypical for N2.
